description: Rename map for tools/build-addon. Applied to the copied Lua/XML/TOC text in dist/Wayfinder, never to the repo. Every replacement stays on its line (no rule may contain a newline), so in-game error line numbers match the repo. Layer 1 = 'identifiers' (+ 'calls', 'strings'), layer 2 = 'keepLiterals' and the guide-file scope, layer 3 = 'branding'. Regexes are JavaScript syntax; 'pattern' in identifier rules is anchored by the engine as described per section.

guideFiles.reason: Upstream guide files: their RegisterGuide long strings are guide TEXT and stay byte-identical. Only the two globals they use as code are renamed (owner approved rewriting RXPGuides.RegisterGuide( and RXP.enabledLocale by script).

fileReferences.reason: Values of XML file= attributes (<Script>/<Include> manifest entries, texture files) and TOC file lines name files on disk. Renaming them without renaming the file breaks loading (e.g. Guides/forever/RestedXP-Skyborne.lua), so only the listed rules apply: the Interface\AddOns\RXPGuides\ folder prefix. The TOC transform touches SavedVariables lines only.

verbatim.reason: Bundled third-party libraries (Ace3, HereBeDragons, ...): never edited; library names must stay as their authors registered them.

exact.reason: SavedVariable (account): must not share a name with RestedXP's, or both addons read and write one table.
Public global table (RegisterGuide entry point); RestedXP defines the same global.
Debug global set to the addon table (RXPGuides.lua); guide files read RXP.enabledLocale.
Read of the RestedXP Themes companion addon's global. Wayfinder does not load its themes (dropped from OptionalDeps); the renamed read finds nil and returns early.
AceComm prefix: Wayfinder must not exchange messages with RestedXP clients.
Macro name created by Targeting.lua; account/character macro names are shared with RestedXP.

prefix.reason: Names built from the RXPGuidesV2_ prefix.
AceGUI widget types, V2 frame and template names.
AceEvent messages, StaticPopup keys, menu frames (guide colour keys are excluded by keepLiterals).
Other addon-defined names: frames (RXPFrame, RXPItemFrame, RXPTargetFrame...), secure buttons (RXPTELEPORTTO), fields.
Lower-camel field and local names (frame.rxpShadow ...): internal, renamed so no RXP residue remains in code.

infix.reason: RXP inside a name: BINDING_HEADER_RXP..., $parentRXP..., RegisterRXPV2..., isRXP.

keepLiterals.reason: Guide colour keys: guide text writes |cRXP_WARN_...|r and the engine looks the key up in addon.guideTextColors; both sides stay upstream-named.
Lua pattern that finds guide colour keys in guide text (map.lua, SettingsPanel.lua ReplaceColors).
Group-name constant compared with guide.group (GuideWindow.lua createMenu); the only user-visible use (Baganator plugin label) is renamed first by the 'calls' rule.

calls.reason: Plugin label shown in Baganator's junk-plugin list.

strings.reason: Hard-coded Interface\AddOns\RXPGuides\ texture paths: the addon folder is Wayfinder. Case-insensitive; the slash style of each occurrence is kept.
Help text naming the slash command.
Help text naming the slash command.
Help text naming the slash command ("/rxp splits", "|cff909090/rxp|r"); texture paths such as /Textures/rxp_logo are not matched.

keep.reason: Names of RestedXP guide groups (and their translations): they credit RestedXP as author of the upstream guides and many are matched against the #group line of guide text, so they stay.
Theme author credit (Themes.lua) and the group-prefix comparison groupOrContent:sub(1,8) == "RestedXP" (GuideLoader.lua).
Lua patterns matching upstream guide group names (GuideLoader.lua).
Attribution line required by CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

rules.reason: Product name in UI text (window titles, welcome text).
Product name in UI/error text ("RXPGuides - Error trying to include guide").
Product name in UI text (chat prefix "RestedXP: ", Leveling Report, menus, feedback form, translations).
Short product name in UI text ("RXP users", theme names "RXP Blue", "RXP Beta"); cRXP_ markup is not a word match.
